FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_SequentialAssignment
VAR_INPUT
    i : INT;              // Input value
END_VAR

VAR
    a, b, c, d0 : INT;    // Intermediate variables
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    o : INT;              // Output value
END_VAR

// Main program logic
a := i;        // Assign input value to a
b := a;       // Assign value of a to b
c := b;       // Assign value of b to c
d0 := c;      // Assign value of c to d0
o := d0;      // Assign value of d0 to output variable o

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

PROGRAM MAIN
VAR
    fbAssignment : FB_SequentialAssignment; // Instance of the function block
    inputValue : INT := 3;                  // Input value to be passed
END_VAR

// Call the function block with the input value
fbAssignment(i := inputValue);

// The output can be accessed via fbAssignment.o
END_PROGRAM
